g.text: Open these jumpers to disable the LEDs
Pull CH342_EN low or close jumper to isolate the CH342 and allow full access to the UART breakout pins and JST connectors

USB Track Impedance: Coplanar Differential Pair @ 90Ω https://jlcpcb.com/pcb-impedance-calculator Board Thickness: 1.6mm. Layers: 4. Er: 4.4 (7628 Prepreg) Dielectric Thickness (Layer 1 to 2): 8.28mil/0.21mm (JLC7628) Copper Thickness (1oz outer / 0.5oz inner): 1.38mil/0.035mm Polygon Isolation: 7mil/0.1778mm Trace Spacing: 9.07mil/0.2304mm Trace Width: 10.93mil/0.2776mm Trace center-to-center: 20.0mil/0.508mm
Close jumpers to enable I2C pull-ups
COM1 + I²C: Signals and directions are compatible with the Pixhawk Basic GPS Port.
JST Pin 1 is 5V by default. Change these jumpers to isolate or select 3.3V.
COM2: Signals and directions replicate the Pixhawk Telemetry Port. A radio can be connected directly to this port.
Pull CH342_EN low to isolate CH342

Microstrip (Coplanar Single Ended) 50Ω Calculation: https://jlcpcb.com/pcb-impedance-calculator Board thickness: 1.6mm. Layers: 4. Er: 4.4 (7628 Prepreg) Dielectric Thickness (Layer 1 to 2): 8.28mil/0.2104mm (JLC7628) Copper Thickness (1oz outer / 0.5oz inner): 1.38mil/0.035mm Polygon Isolation: 7mil/0.1778mm Trace Width: 11.1mil/0.2819mm
Note: the antenna GNDs are isolated from each other and the other board GNDs. Antenna GND is connected through the u.FL cables only - to avoid ground loops.
Open jumper when connecting external battery or power
